comments.body:
Produced with Transmutation Alchemy using Vainqueur Armour as a base item. R12 Casting/Alchemy are required; I presume the ingredients are also x1 Orichalcum + x5 Special Purchase Bond + x5 Check (10 million㌦) as is usually the case with most Maris EX Effect recipes. Please correct me if I'm wrong. Stats:

Accuracy +2
Guard +1
Ballistics +1 / fame 20000
EX Effect Increase special shot effects R10
40k total fame + Vainqueur title to equip
